    Bricks among string and band modules #

    A brick is indecomposable, so in the decomposition it is a single piece (unique_of_isBrick_pi). A block module whose blocks have dimension at least two has a nonzero non-injective blockwise endomorphism, so a brick piece has one-dimensional blocks (finrank_eq_one_of_isBrick). A band piece with one-dimensional blocks is some M(b, t) (exists_equiv_BM).
